Free, MIT-licensed source. Run Cutroom locally with Docker, or give the repository to your coding agent for guided setup.

Get it on GitHub ↗

Requires Git, Python 3.10+, and Docker. Provider-backed AI and upload transcription need your own API credentials; provider fees may apply.

A few things to know.

Is this a hosted editor?

No. This page introduces Cutroom. The editing app runs on your own machine using Docker. The repository includes setup instructions for you or a local coding agent.

Does it publish directly to social platforms?

No. Review and export your finished MP4s, then share them with your own publishing tools. Calendar scheduling, social account connections, and automatic delivery are not available.

Do I still review the clips?

Yes. Ranking, speaker tracking, duplicate detection, and quality inspection assist your edit; they don’t replace your judgment. Review framing, sync, subtitles, and source rights before sharing.

What stays on my machine?

Your app database and working media are stored locally. YouTube downloads and enabled AI providers make external requests. Review the repository’s security guidance before adding credentials or sensitive footage.

LONG-FORM IN. GREAT CLIPS OUT.
